name: goad
summary: Game of Active Directory — multi-forest Windows AD lab (not runnable on this host)
notes: GOAD needs several x86 Windows VMs (VirtualBox/VMware/Proxmox/AWS) and 24 GB+ RAM. Build it on a separate lab host (https://github.com/Orange-Cyberdefense/GOAD), fill ground-truth.json from the GOAD docs for the lab variant you deploy, and score with `score goad tzar:<OUTPUT_DIR>`.
